enableHeroic.Name: Enable Heroic Actions
enableHeroic.Hint: Natural 20s on qualifying rolls award Heroic Actions.

enableVillainous.Name: Enable Villainous Actions
enableVillainous.Hint: Natural 1s on qualifying rolls award Villainous Actions.

advantagePolicy.Name: Advantage & Disadvantage Handling
advantagePolicy.Hint: Selected result only (default): only the d20 used for the final outcome can award. Any die: every d20 in the roll can award, including the unselected die (more generous; a roll with 1 and 20 awards both). Ordinary rolls only: rolls made with advantage or disadvantage never award.

rerollPolicy.Name: Reroll Handling
rerollPolicy.Hint: Final result (default): dice replaced by a reroll (e.g. Halfling Lucky) are ignored and the kept die decides. Exclude rerolled rolls: any roll in which the primary d20 was rerolled never awards.

npcGeneration.Name: NPCs Earn Resources
npcGeneration.Hint: When enabled, NPC rolls also generate Heroic and Villainous Actions. The GM can always grant resources to NPCs manually.

capBehavior.Name: Behavior at the Resource Cap
capBehavior.Hint: What happens when a qualifying roll cannot award because the pool already holds three.

notificationMode.Name: Award Chat Notifications
notificationMode.Hint: Where to announce earned resources: publicly, privately to the owners and GM, or not at all.

showToasts.Name: Show Toast Notifications
showToasts.Hint: Show a brief UI notification when one of your characters earns a resource (per client).

countOutsideCombat.Name: Count Rolls Outside Combat
countOutsideCombat.Hint: When disabled, only rolls made while a combat encounter is active generate resources.

activationPolicy.Name: Activation Policy
activationPolicy.Hint: Flexible: use each ability's own activation requirements. Legendary-style: off-turn use only for reactions and special activations, limited per round. Turn-bound: only on the character's own turn unless the ability is a reaction or special activation. GM-controlled: the GM must approve every activation.

legendaryUsesPerRound.Name: Legendary-style Uses per Round
legendaryUsesPerRound.Hint: Maximum off-turn activations per combat round under the Legendary-style policy (0 = unlimited).

allowAbilityOutsideCombat.Name: Allow Abilities Outside Combat
allowAbilityOutsideCombat.Hint: Players may activate abilities when no combat is active.

requireGMApprovalForAutomation.Name: GM Approval for Automated Abilities
requireGMApprovalForAutomation.Hint: Automated abilities defined by players must be approved by the GM before they can be used. Any change to their mechanics resets approval.

defaultCost.Name: Default Resource Cost
defaultCost.Hint: Default number of actions an ability costs when it is first defined.

playersCanEditAbilities.Name: Players May Edit Definitions
playersCanEditAbilities.Hint: Owners can edit the name, description and mechanics of their abilities after the first definition.

playersCanUseManualWithoutApproval.Name: Manual Abilities Without Approval
playersCanUseManualWithoutApproval.Hint: Players may use manual (descriptive) abilities without prior GM approval.

requirePublicChat.Name: Require Public Activation Messages
requirePublicChat.Hint: Activation cards are always public, ignoring the user's roll mode.

allowAdminOverride.Name: Allow Administrative Override
allowAdminOverride.Hint: Let the GM set resource counts above the maximum of three. Overrides are logged in the actor's history.

diagnostics.Name: Diagnostics Logging
diagnostics.Hint: Log every classification decision to the console and the GM management diagnostics tab (per client).

showSheetCard.Name: Show Sheet Card
showSheetCard.Hint: Show the Heroic & Villainous card on character and NPC sheets (per client).

GMManagement.Name: GM Management
GMManagement.Label: Manage Resources
GMManagement.Hint: Adjust, set and reset resources, review ability definitions and inspect roll diagnostics.

SettingsHelp.Name: Rules Reference
SettingsHelp.Label: Open Rules Reference
SettingsHelp.Hint: Documentation of the rules, policies and their defaults.

deathSave.Name: Death Saving Throws
deathSave.Hint: Death saving throws (off by default: a natural 20 already restores the character).

unknown.Name: Unknown
unknown.Hint: Roll of unknown provenance; never awards.

Help.Title: Heroic & Villainous Actions — Rules Reference
Help.Rules: A natural 20 on a qualifying d20 test earns one Heroic Action; a natural 1 earns one Villainous Action. The die face is what matters, never the modified total. Each pool holds at most three; a full pool ignores further awards. Activating an ability costs one action by default and never more than the character holds. Cancelling any dialog never spends a resource.

Advantage.selected: Only the die used for the outcome counts. Advantage rolling 1 and 20 and keeping 20 earns a Heroic Action; disadvantage keeping the 1 earns a Villainous Action. Unselected dice never award. Recommended default.
Advantage.any: Every d20 in the roll counts, including discarded dice. A roll showing both 1 and 20 earns one of each. More generous and more random.
Advantage.ordinaryOnly: Rolls made with advantage or disadvantage never award. Strict and easy to adjudicate.

Reroll.final: Dice replaced by a reroll (Halfling Lucky, Lucky feat rerolls processed by the system) are ignored; the final kept die decides. No roll awards twice.
Reroll.excludeRerolled: Any roll in which the primary d20 was rerolled never awards.

Activation.flexible: Each ability's own activation type and trigger apply. Reactions and special activations can be used off-turn; others are expected on the character's turn, enforced at the table.
Activation.legendary: Off-turn activation is allowed only for abilities whose activation is Reaction or Special, limited to the configured number of uses per round (as Legendary Actions are limited per turn cycle). On the character's own turn any ability may be used.
Activation.turnBound: Abilities may only be used on the character's own turn unless their activation type is Reaction or Special.
Activation.gmControlled: Every activation is sent to the active GM for approval before the resource is spent.

Help.Economy: Spending a Heroic or Villainous Action never grants an extra ordinary action, bonus action or reaction: the ability's activation type states what it consumes. An ability with the Reaction type uses the character's reaction; one with the Special type is an extra, Legendary-style activation that interrupts the normal turn order and should define its trigger. Opportunity attacks and concentration follow the normal rules.
Help.Modes: Manual abilities are descriptions: the module posts them to chat and spends the resource, and the table resolves the effect. Automated abilities are built from supported mechanics (damage and healing links, saves, checks, temporary HP, conditions, templates, prompts) executed by trusted module code. Player-written text is never executed as code.
Help.Permissions: Owners may use and define abilities for their actors. Editing after the first definition can be restricted to the GM. Only the GM can adjust counts, reset pools, approve automation or exceed the cap (with the override setting, which is logged). World settings cannot be changed by players.
